title: GitHub&\#x27;s Rubicon storage reports 7,200 pushes per second
summary: GitHub has introduced Rubicon, a new Git storage architecture designed for large numbers of AI agents operating concurrently on a single repository. In internal testing, it supported 5,000 agents working together and processed 7,200 pushes per second while keeping read latency low; these are vendor-reported results from a limited private preview, not a broadly available or independently measured capability. The architecture stores Git objects in Azure Blob Storage, manages reference state with Ref-CAS, uses virtual replicas for reads and writes, and relies on background nodes to compact packfiles. GitHub says it will gradually expand the preview.

references.title: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture - The GitHub Blog
